technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish technicals (TEMA cross, Supertrend, Hull) conflicting with bearish intermediate structure (price below all major MAs, Ichimoku below cloud, negative CMF); weak confluence and neutral sector momentum do not support high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, and earnings in 18 days present elevated risk with minimal conviction support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 buy vs 1 sale, small amounts, junior members) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (334.6), strong dollar pressures multinational revenues, NFP event today adds volatility, and earnings in 18 days create binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: TEMA cross-up, Supertrend bullish, and Hull bullish signals combined with extreme fear sentiment (18/100) offer contrarian entry opportunity near support at 99.54.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, Ichimoku below cloud, negative CMF, high earnings risk in 18 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (334.6), and zero active strategy triggers create overwhelming structural headwinds that dwarf short-term technical bounces.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear sentiment (18/100) and short-term technical bounces (TEMA cross, Supertrend bullish) offer contrarian appeal, overwhelming structural headwinds—price below all major MAs, Ichimoku below cloud, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and high earnings risk in 18 days—create unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 18 days combined with macro recession signals (inverted yield curve, VIX 334.6) could trigger sharp downside break below support at 99.54, negating any short-term bounce.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
